reference_definition: unique sequences in curated paper_training.npz with MIC <= 2 uM (includes both fixed partitions)
candidate_definition: regression Top400, identical to SI clustering pool
identity_definition: maximum over all positive references of exact matches / total global alignment columns including gaps * 100
alignment: Needleman-Wunsch; match +1, mismatch -1, linear gap -1 including terminal gaps; traceback ties diagonal/up/left
property_notes: h = negative mean Kyte-Doolittle; i = normalized hydrophobic moment at 100 degrees per residue; k = mean Kyte-Doolittle, not physical penetration depth; charge at pH7; pI via zero-charge bisection
